filo duplicates
filo duplicates exclude DIR
filo duplicates include PATH

  Lists what is not counted as duplicates: excluded directories, contents always
  and sets of records. Contents always and sets of records are made in a
  duplicates CSV (always on every row of a group, or keep on two or more copies)
  and carried out by filo delete FILE.

  exclude makes the files under DIR, a directory inside a root, never count as
  duplicates, of each other or of files elsewhere. They are still scanned and
  their retentions are unchanged. It replaces the exclusions under DIR.

  include undoes one of them: for a directory, its exclusion; for a file, its
  content always, or its whole set of records. PATH may be gone from the disk.
